newsitem.title: USA: New Mexico man who murdered friend kills himself.
newsitem.headline: New Mexico man who murdered friend kills himself.

text.p: A New Mexico man who chopped off his best friend's head and tossed it into a dumpster during a drug and alcohol binge in 1992 killed himself in prison Thursday, officials said.

Vincent Kaydahzinne, a 25-year-old Mescalero Apache Indian, was found hanging by a belt that he had twisted into a noose in a Santa Fe prison cell where he was serving a life sentence for the 1992 murder of Joseph Loretto, his close friend.

Kaydahzinne testified during his murder trial that he and Loretto, a Jemez Indian, had consumed large amounts of LSD, mescaline, crack cocaine, whisky and beer during a three-day binge when they argued and he flew into a rage.

Police found Loretto's headless corpse in Kaydahzinne's apartment in the southern New Mexico town of Las Cruces. Kaydahzinne had cut open the body with a kitchen knife, thrown the heart into a neighbour's back yard and tossed the head into a dumpster.
Defence attorneys said Kaydahzinne was in an alcoholic blackout at the time of the murder but a jury convicted him of first degree murder after deliberating for just 25 minutes.
